visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A well-groomed man with brown hair and a stylish white button-down shirt stands in a high-end retail space. Behind him are stacked vintage-style brown trunks with gold accents. The lighting is warm and bright, highlighting the luxurious atmosphere of the cream-walled room. He holds a small black object and gestures toward the camera with his free hand. (2) The man walks through large glass doors into the main store area. The interior features white minimalist counters and sleek product displays. He spreads his arms wide to showcase the multi-story space, which includes a red-carpeted staircase. Passersby in dark clothing are visible in the background, maintaining professional distance. (3) Medium and close-up shots show the man at a curved display table with a colorful gradient front. He holds a black lipstick tube and applies a vivid red swatch to his inner forearm, revealing tattoos. His facial expressions are animated and cheerful, often smiling directly at the lens while pointing to rows of makeup. (4) The scene transitions to the man holding a white-cased lip balm and later a round, black-and-gold eyeshadow palette. Close-up shots focus on the intricate monogram patterns on the packaging and his hands delicately touching the product. The store background remains consistently bright with high-end accessories visible on white shelving units. (5) He presents a foldable brown pouch with the classic brand monogram. Upon opening it, a set of five golden-handled makeup brushes is revealed against a white lining. The man demonstrates the brushes' feel near his face, displaying high energy and engaging expressions while the camera uses fast cuts to emphasize product details. (6) He shows a small monogram-patterned leather pouch. He opens it using a snap button to reveal white blotting papers inside. He dabs one on his face to demonstrate its use. The camera alternates between his face and the small accessory, capturing his approving nods and the store's sophisticated interior design. (7) Back in the initial location near the large trunks, the man summarizes his visit. He waves goodbye with a broad smile and walks off-camera. The lighting remains soft yet professional, and the overall color palette is warm and upscale. The final shot captures the empty store display before cutting to a black screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male voice speaking Mandarin at a rapid pace with clear articulation. The background music is an upbeat electronic track featuring synth chords and a steady drum machine beat at approximately 110 BPM. There is no significant ambient noise, creating a studio-clean acoustic environment that focuses on the speaker's enthusiastic narrative tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition in the visual narrative, immediately followed by the speaker continuing his high-arousal delivery. The BGM remains constant, maintaining a major-mode tonality that feels optimistic and professional. The speaker's vocal pitch is moderately high, with frequent variations to emphasize the luxury of the products described. (3) A distinct metallic 'click' sound is heard as the speaker introduces a specific item. This is followed by a series of shorter 'swish' sound effects synchronized with visual edits. The music bed ducks slightly during these moments to allow the vocal clarity to remain at a broadcast-quality level, with high spectral brightness and no technical distortion. (4) Another 'pop' sound effect occurs as a new category of makeup is presented. The speaker's voice exhibits high dominance and positive valence, conveying excitement and authority. The electronic BGM persists with its rhythmic synth bass line, providing a dynamic pulse that matches the fast editing pace of the video. (5) A clear 'ding' or bell-like sound effect punctuates the mention of a price point. The vocal prosody becomes more dramatic with exaggerated pauses and inflections. The ambient floor remains silent, suggesting a controlled retail recording or high-quality post-production noise reduction. (6) The final phase features a rhythmic build-up in the music followed by a final exclamation from the speaker. A 'bye-bye' vocal cue is delivered with a friendly, falling intonation. The BGM fades out quickly with a smooth volume ramp, leaving a brief moment of silence before the track ends, maintaining high production standards throughout.
